name: Totality
description: A total eclipse in every cell: the black disc of the moon, a pale corona fading around it, long streamers, and one bright bead of the diamond ring on its edge.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: @r(0deg, 360deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 40%, var(--color1) 40%, transparent 100%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -26%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform: rotate(@var(--t)); mask: conic-gradient(#000 0deg 9deg, transparent 9deg 38deg, #000 38deg 43deg, transparent 43deg 84deg, #000 84deg 97deg, transparent 97deg 140deg, #000 140deg 146deg, transparent 146deg 176deg, #000 176deg 188deg, transparent 188deg 228deg, #000 228deg 233deg, transparent 233deg 262deg, #000 262deg 276deg, transparent 276deg 318deg, #000 318deg 324deg, transparent 324deg 360deg), radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 26.5%, #000 27.5%, transparent 100%); mask-composite: intersect; opacity: 0.75; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 9%; height: 9%; left: calc(50% + 20% * cos(@var(--t)) - 4.5%); top: calc(50% + 20% * sin(@var(--t)) - 4.5%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
